summary.text: Mike Hoadley is a Republican state representative from Michigan House of Representatives District 99 who has served since January 1, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An Army veteran and former mayor of Au Gres, he chairs the House Economic Competitiveness Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mike Hoadley was born in Flint, Michigan, and served in the U.S. Army from 1990 to 1994.
He graduated from Au Gres High School and later owned Hunters Niche Inc. and worked as a customer relations manager.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Hoadley said he was elected to the Au Gres City Council in 2017 and re-elected in 2020, chaired the Arenac County Planning Commission, and served as mayor of Au Gres.
Hoadley's 2025 and 2026 committee assignments are Economic Competitiveness, which he chairs, Elections and Ethics, Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation, and House Regulatory Reform.
In the same 2022 survey, he named free speech, the Second Amendment, election integrity, personal property rights and the right to life among his top issues.
